scope: one-time approved ordinary input comparison; actual production JS in controlled DOM fixtures and Rust whitelist/gate tests, not installed/WebKit acceptance
change: Input only fixed matched/mismatched/unverified; compare approved ordinary field once, no values returned. Transient password/OTP and DOM mutation unverified.
limits: matched means only same approved ordinary field matched at the reply instant; no website submission proof
any DOM mutation during input handlers yields unverified, including benign re-render, to avoid temporarily protected/restored fields
withdrawn or missing native receipts keep existing generic unknown with no verification; description treats a missing verification as unverified
no form values or input history added to observe or replies
